decisions.reason: The reset-input details do not change the independently specified GPIO button and slide-switch inputs, whose message-320 clauses are already represented.
The reset-input modification does not alter the independently specified TTP223 touch interfaces, whose message-320 clauses are already represented.
Message 320 does not change or further specify the PIR sensor connector.
The panel reset connection is a main-board control detail and does not change the sensor board's role as a sensor connector hub.
The EN-to-GND reset action is unrelated to the addressable LED power, level shifting, and shutdown interface.
The reset-input specification does not change the separate eight-LED array board.
The reset connector and EN-to-GND behavior do not affect I2C cable, pull-up, or series-resistor requirements.
The panel reset input does not change the interboard power connector type, pin count, or pin-order rule.
The detailed reset control remains consistent with the existing main-board system-connector role and does not change the three-board architecture.
Connecting the ESP32 EN reset input to GND is distinct from controlling the MT3608 5V rail enable through GPIO5.
The reset-input details do not alter the charge-status LED circuit or connector requirements.
The panel reset control does not change standalone USB power regulation, source selection, or powered loads.
